title: Mike Macdonald: We're excited about the running backs in our building

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald: We're excited about the running backs in our building
sources.description: The Seahawks saw Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker leave for Kansas City early in free agency and they haven't made a big splash to replace him in their backfield, but it isn't an area of great concern for head coach Mike Macdonald.
